project: Oglesby Road data center campus (Compass Datacenters)
action: City Council voted 4-1 to add Compass Datacenters parcels to the campus rezoned in May, expanding it from about 830 to about 886 acres. Plans described in the source show ten buildings, an on-site substation, and an Oncor switching station.
why: If it survives the pending suit and moves into permits, a campus this size is years of site work, concrete, electrical, and steel. A rezoning vote is not a start date. DFW job, not Central Texas.
notes: A lawsuit over the May rezoning is still pending.
source_name: Texas Construction Hub, 19 Nov 2026 (trade press, from 20 Nov AM watch)

action: Reported: City Council voted 6-0 to approve a development agreement with Union Pacific for the 2,040-acre rail-served park, projected at about 20 million sq ft and about $2.5 billion (projection, not a contract), no city funds, TIRZ possible later.
why: Once confirmed, a rail-served park at that scale is multi-year site work and building construction. Not a job bidding this month.
notes: Vote, acreage, and dollar figure all unverified until the official packet or minutes are checked.
source_name: myopentexas.org meeting summary, AI-written (from 20 Nov PM watch)
